title: Insight into the interactions between microplastics and heavy metals in agricultural soil solution: adsorption performance influenced by microplastic types
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2049-2062
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00144G, Paper
Yu-liang Liao, Chun-dan Gan, Xue Zhao, Xin-yue Du, Jin-yan Yang
Microplastics (MPs) are widely present in soils, often co-contaminated with heavy metals (HMs), complicating the assessment of their adsorption performance.
